_comment: apps: deployed Modal apps, read from `modal app list`. This is the ground truth the check compares against, and it never comes from the SDK's own constants. defaults: what each hosted default resolves to right now, recorded so a reviewer can diff the function segment, which the Modal CLI cannot verify. Refresh in the same PR as any deployment change. known_dead: hosts with no deployed replacement, each naming the issue that tracks it. The list may shrink and never grow; a dead host outside it fails CI.

known_dead.DEFAULT_STUDIO_URL: app zeroproof-studio was never redeployed; probed 404; tracked in #804
known_dead.DEFAULT_EMBED_URL: app zeroproof-embed was never redeployed; probed 404; tracked in #804
